title: OpenAI is giving 100,000 scientists free AI. Here’s how it can afford to.

content_html:
OpenAI made two announcements this week that look unrelated. One is generous. The other explains how it can afford to be.

The generous one: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to its frontier models through 2027, Axios reported. The programme, ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, starts with 10,000 users this summer and scales from there.

Free frontier access for scientists

Researchers get GPT-5.6 Sol Pro, OpenAI’s top model, and can each invite up to four collaborators, the company said. Their data is not used to train models by default. Early institutions include the Institute for Advanced Study and the École normale supérieure.

OpenAI frames it as accelerating science, and it forms part of a commitment of more than $250m through 2027 to fund outside research. Greg Brockman called it “more shots on goal against humanity’s hardest problems.”

The 💜 of EU tech

The latest rumblings from the EU tech scene, a story from our wise ol' founder Boris, and some questionable AI art. It's free, every week, in your inbox. Sign up now!

Not everyone reads it so warmly. Sceptics note the flywheel: hook researchers on a capped compute budget, learn from what they do, and keep the frontier compute in-house. Getting a generation of scientists to think inside ChatGPT is its own kind of moat.

The engine underneath

The second announcement is drier, and it is the reason the first is possible. OpenAI detailed how it slashed the cost of running its agents, The Deep View reported.

The key piece is the agent harness. It sits under Codex and ChatGPT Work and directs the model, the tools and the context like a conductor. It is open-source, unlike Anthropic’s Claude Code. It is also a token furnace. Early this year, some developers ran up $20,000 monthly bills as agents burned through compute.

So OpenAI optimised it. GPT-5.6 Sol now beats Claude Fable 5 on a leading coding benchmark while using 54% fewer output tokens, the company says. A lighter model, GPT-5.5 Luna, costs 80% less than Sol.

The model that cut its own bill

The neatest detail is recursive. Using Codex, GPT-5.6 rewrote and optimised OpenAI’s own production kernels, the low-level code that runs the models, The New Stack reported. OpenAI says that lifted token efficiency by more than 15%. The model helped cut its own cost.

The timing is not an accident. Enterprises have soured on “tokenmaxxing,” the habit of throwing raw compute at every task. Databricks says curbing AI cost is the top question it now hears from customers.

Two sides of one strategy

Put together, the two moves are a single play. Cheaper inference lets OpenAI give models away at the top of the funnel, to 100,000 scientists and to the other 990 million ChatGPT users it wants on agents. Generosity and cost control are the same strategy.

There is a risk in it. Free frontier tools deepen the field’s dependence on one company’s stack, at the exact moment OpenAI is learning to run that stack for less. The cheaper it gets to serve, the more the world it serves belongs to OpenAI. Anthropic, as one poster put it, gets the next move.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 本周发布了两项看似无关的公告。 一是慷慨。 另一个解释了它如何负担得起。

据 Axios 报道，慷慨的一件事是：到 2027 年，OpenAI 将为 100,000 名学术研究人员免费提供其前沿模型。 该项目名为 ChatGPT for Academy Researcher，于今年夏天开始吸引 10,000 名用户，并在此基础上不断扩大规模。

科学家免费进入边境

该公司表示，研究人员可以获得 OpenAI 的顶级模型 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro，每个人最多可以邀请四名合作者。 默认情况下，他们的数据不用于训练模型。 早期的机构包括高等研究院和高等师范学院。

OpenAI 将其定义为加速科学发展，它是到 2027 年资助外部研究超过 2.5 亿美元的承诺的一部分。 格雷格·布罗克曼称其为“针对人类最棘手问题的更多射门”。

欧盟科技的💜

来自欧盟科技界的最新传言、我们明智的创始人鲍里斯的故事，以及一些值得怀疑的人工智能艺术。 每周都会免费发送到您的收件箱中。 立即注册！

并不是每个人都读得那么热情。 怀疑论者注意到了飞轮：让研究人员接受有限的计算预算，从他们所做的事情中学习，并将前沿计算保留在内部。 让一代科学家在 ChatGPT 内部思考是它自己的护城河。

发动机在下面

第二个公告比较干燥，这也是第一个公告成为可能的原因。 据 Deep View 报道，OpenAI 详细介绍了它如何削减代理运行成本。

关键部分是特工安全带。 它位于 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 之下，像指挥一样指导模型、工具和上下文。 与 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 不同，它是开源的。 这也是一个令牌熔炉。 今年年初，由于代理消耗了计算资源，一些开发人员每月的账单高达 20,000 美元。

所以OpenAI对其进行了优化。 该公司表示，GPT-5.6 Sol 现在在领先的编码基准上击败了 Claude Fable 5，同时使用的输出令牌减少了 54%。 更轻的型号 GPT-5.5 Luna 的成本比 Sol 低 80%。

节省开支的模型

最简洁的细节是递归的。 据 The New Stack 报道，GPT-5.6 使用 Codex 重写并优化了 OpenAI 自己的生产内核，即运行模型的低级代码。 OpenAI 表示，这将代币效率提高了 15% 以上。 该模式有助于降低自身成本。

这个时机并非偶然。 企业已经厌倦了“tokenmaxshing”，即在每项任务中投入原始计算的习惯。 Databricks 表示，抑制人工智能成本是目前从客户那里听到的首要问题。

一项战略的两个方面

放在一起，这两个动作就是一个动作。 更便宜的推理让 OpenAI 将模型提供给漏斗顶部的 10 万名科学家以及它希望通过代理获得的其他 9.9 亿 ChatGPT 用户。 慷慨和成本控制是同一个策略。

其中存在风险。 免费的前沿工具加深了该领域对一家公司堆栈的依赖，而此时 OpenAI 正在学习以更少的成本运行该堆栈。 服务成本越低，它所服务的世界就越属于 OpenAI。 正如一张海报所说，人择将采取下一步行动。
